title: Coarse anticoncentration coefficient
statement: For every real $\lambda>0$ and every positive integer $k$, $(15/\lambda)^{-k}\le \frac14(e^2/(2\lambda))^{-k}$, where the exponents are real powers with exponent $-k$.
replaced: For every $\lambda>0$ and a positive integer $k$, $(15/\lambda)^{-k}\le\tfrac14(e^2/(2\lambda))^{-k}$, where negative powers have real exponents.
